### SignalReplayFrame

`SignalReplayFrame(SignalReplayRun run, SignalReplaySlice slice, int depth)`

<a id="SignalReplayFrame-method-execute"></a>

### execute

`Object execute()` 

**Throws:**

- `SignalReplayException`: …

Runs the instructions of the slice and returns the value they leave.
Throws a [`SignalReplayException`](/reference/signals/signalreplayexception/) when an instruction is not supported or fails.

<a id="SignalReplayFrame-method-convert"></a>

### convert

`Object convert(Object value, Class<?> type)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Converts an `int` of the bytecode to the `boolean`, `char`, `byte` or `short` that `type` expects; any other value passes unchanged.

<a id="SignalReplayFrame-method-isLastLive"></a>

### isLastLive

`boolean isLastLive()` 

If `true`, the last value produced depends on a signal.
